questions: Bakkenのcombination sessionの例では、45/15の前に何をどのくらい行い、間に休止を入れる？
entries.answer: まずイージー走を60〜90分行い、休止を挟まず直接45/15へ移る例です。既知の要素をつないで負荷や焦点を変える特別なバリエーションとして挙げています。

evidence.text: you first run easy for sixty to ninety minutes and then, without pause, go directly into 45/15.
It is therefore a special variant that can be tried for variation and to increase load in periods when you want it.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: Bakkenの時間不足時の優先順位は？時間不足が続く場合のsafety planは？
entries.answer: main quality、support quality、短縮できるロング走、減らせるイージー練習の順です。時間不足が続く場合には最低週1回の閾値練習に絞る安全プランを検討し、セッション間を1週間より長くしないという維持方針を示しています。本書の案内です。

evidence.text: Main quality session - always protected
Support quality session
Long run (can be shortened)
Easy sessions (can be reduced)
minimum one single threshold session per week, but never more than a week between sessions.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのWhen a session falls throughでは、抜けた練習を後日に埋め合わせる？複数回抜けた場合は？
entries.answer: 後日に取り戻そうとせず、次に予定している練習に沿って先へ進む案内です。複数回抜けた場合は45/15を使いながら、イージー走の量も段階的に戻すことを検討します。

evidence.text: Do not try to make up the session later
Stick to the next planned session
Steer forward; do not chase missed sessions
If multiple sessions fall through, consider a gradual approach back to normal training with frequent use of 45/15 alongside gradual progression of easy runs

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのPrecise Intensity Controlで、短い反復ほど速く走れるとしても、計算ペースだけで決めてよい？
entries.answer: 計算ペースだけで決める方針ではありません。短い反復ほど閾値を超えず速く走れるという原則を、心拍や会話テストで確認し、計算ペースで走る場合も反復時間の影響を意識するよう求めています。

evidence.text: the shorter each interval, the faster you can run without exceeding the threshold. You will be able to detect this with heart rate measurement or talk test
be aware of it nonetheless if you choose to run primarily based on calculated pace.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: Bakkenの週4〜6時間の強度調整では、主観と心拍・ペースが合わないとき、どうする方針？
entries.answer: 本書では強度を下げ、わずかに閾値を超えるよりも、そのゾーンの下側を選ぶよう勧めています。反復が進むにつれ、感覚や簡単なテストを心拍・ペースと照合する方針です。

evidence.text: eventually subjective feel and simple tests should align with measurements like heart rate or pace. If not? Then I clearly recommend adjusting down, to rather be in the lower area of this zone than to tip just over.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのPeriodization Explainedでは、周期化を毎週できるだけ強く練習することと説明している？
entries.answer: そうではありません。過負荷を避けながら適応を得るために週・月・年を通して戦略的に負荷を変える計画です。異なる時期の目的はあっても、基本原則から離れず、移行を急にしないと説明しています。

evidence.text: planning training over weeks, months, and years so that the body gets the best possible adaptation without overload.
periodization means varying the load strategically.
no transitions should be too abrupt and never far from the basic principles.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: Bakkenのvariation principleでは、頭打ちになる前から周期化を最初の手段にする？挙げている順序は？
entries.answer: 練習配分を選ぶ、各セッション内で休止・反復長・構成・路面を変える、適切な強度の制御を続ける、そのうえで頭打ちになったら周期化を選ぶという順序です。

evidence.text: Choose your training distribution.
Vary within each session. Adjust rests, interval length, composition, and surface around sessions. This comes first.
Practice intensity control.
Periodize when progress plateaus.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: Bakkenは全員に最適な周期化モデルが1つあるとしている？安定した構造と変化のある時期をどう扱う？
entries.answer: 全員に完璧な1つのモデルはないと述べています。年間を通した平坦で安定した構造が合う人も、変化のある期間が合う人もおり、いずれも急な移行を避けて徐々に次の段階へ移る方針です。

evidence.text: there is no completely perfect periodization model for absolutely everyone. Some thrive best with a flat, stable structure through the year
Others respond better to more varied training periods.
always glide gradually from one phase to another, always with gradual transitions

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: Bakkenのflat structureから競技へ近づけるモデルでは、mainとsupportの質練習も毎週大きく入れ替える？
entries.answer: mainとsupportは残し、X-sessionの方を徐々に競技の要求へ近づける説明です。基礎期の比較的似た週を保ちながらX-sessionを尖らせ、競技が高強度練習を引き継ぐ位置付けです。

evidence.text: a flat training structure through base training, with an X-session that progressively becomes more and more sharpened toward com-petitions. Competitions eventually take over for intensive training.
The main quality session and support quality session stay in place. The X-session is where progression happens

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのX-session progressionの説明では、イージー日を2日置くなら前後のどちらを特に重視している？
entries.answer: X-session前の2日を勧め、著者の経験では後に2日置くことよりも前の配置を重視しています。これは本書の経験に基づく案内で、けがを必ず防ぐ保証ではありません。

evidence.text: ideally add two easy days before the X-session to ensure you do not get injured. My experience is that this is much more important than possibly two easy days afterward.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのKristoffer Ingebrigtsen・James Copelandに触れる簡略化モデルは、週の閾値・イージー走とテスト走をどう組む？
entries.answer: 基本は週3回のsub-thresholdとイージー走3回で、4〜6週ごとにテスト走による少し強い負荷を入れると説明しています。Kristofferが忙しい生活で試し、James Copelandが発展させたバリエーションとして紹介しています。

evidence.text: Kristoffer Ingebrigtsen, trying it out to get in shape in a busy daily life. The variant has been further developed by Englishman James Copeland.
three threshold sessions per week (that is, sub-threshold
three easy runs, and a slightly harder load approximately every fourth to sixth week in the form of a test run.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.

questions: BakkenのBlock Periodizationで、2週高負荷・1週軽めの基本例と、3週目にX-sessionへ寄せる代案の注意点は？
entries.answer: 基本例は2週の高めの練習量と一部のダブル閾値の後、1週の総量と負荷を減らした練習です。3週目に量を大きく落として閾値の一部を中程度のX-session2回へ置き換える代案もありますが、こちらは危険が高く慎重に試すとしています。

evidence.text: 2 weeks with higher training volume and some double threshold days
1 week with light training and reduced total volume
replacing some of the threshold work with two moderately intense X-sessions. The risk is higher, so this approach should be tried with caution.

review.scope: Book-specific scheduling, variations and periodization; gradual and individual application, no guarantee.
